Blue Candle (the bead's first sub-fixture) does NOT exist in STS2 at pin 01c094d — confirmed via grep over sts2_env/ + sts2-wiki/decompiled/v0.103.2/ (zero hits); that half of the bead text is STS1-memory drift (see auto-memory feedback_bead_text_from_sts1_memory) and is intentionally omitted.
